recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-5245; any future Bundle type wording concern should be handled under a new or more specific tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-5245 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core ballot issue asking to clarify Bundle wording that described exchanging resources as part of a message transaction, because that blurred the difference between message and transaction bundle types.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-5245 was found. Commit 368c9c3074e changed the Bundle introduction from 'Exchanging a set of resources as part of a message transaction' to 'Sending a set of resources as part of a message exchange' and added a separate transaction bullet before the Jira comment approved the continuous-build wording on 2015-02-12.
additional_context: Bundle is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/bundle feeds the current build. The current Bundle introduction keeps message exchange separate from transaction processing, Bundle.type defines the purpose of each type, and the Bundle Type code system separately defines message, transaction, and transaction-response. Later same-area history did not reintroduce the confusing phrase, and no conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch because the current build-scope source already contains the accepted clarification.

related_jiras.note: A later no-change complaint about Bundle.type definitions; checked to ensure it did not reopen the FHIR-5245 wording question.
